heading: Stakeholders Relationship Committee

chapter.title: OBLIGATIONS OF 76[A] LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS SPECIFIED SECURITIES 77[AND NON-CONVERTIBLE DEBT SECURITIES]

content:
20. (1) The listed entity shall constitute a Stakeholders Relationship Committee to
specifically look into 186[various aspects of interest] of shareholders, debenture holders
and other security holders.
(2) The chairperson of this committee shall be a non-executive director.
187[(2A) At least three directors, with at least one being an independent director, shall be
members of the Committee 188[and in case of a listed entity having outstanding SR equity
shares, at least two thirds of the Stakeholders Relationship Committee shall comprise of
independent directors].]
189[(3) The Chairperson of the Stakeholders Relationship Committee shall be present at the
annual general meetings to answer queries of the security holders.]
190[(3A) The stakeholders relationship committee shall meet at least once in a 191[financial]
year.]
(4) The role of the Stakeholders Relationship Committee shall be as specified as in Part D of
the Schedule II.

footnotes.text:
186 Substituted for the words “the mechanism of redressal of grievances” by the SEBI (Listing Obligations and
